# Multi-Stage Dockerfile for Node.js TypeScript Application

## Project Structure
```
├── src/
│   └── index.ts
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
├── tsconfig.json
└── Dockerfile
```

## Supporting Files

**tsconfig.json**
```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2020",
    "module": "commonjs",
    "lib": ["ES2020"],
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": true,
    "sourceMap": false        
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*"],
  "exclude": ["node_modules", "dist", "**/*.test.ts"]
}
```

**package.json**
```json
{
  "name": "my-ts-app",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc",
    "start": "node dist/index.js",
    "dev": "ts-node src/index.ts",
    "test": "jest"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "express": "^4.18.2"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/express": "^4.17.21",
    "@types/node": "^20.10.0",
    "typescript": "^5.3.2"
  }
}
```

**.dockerignore**
```
node_modules
dist
.git
.gitignore
*.md
.env*
coverage
.nyc_output
*.log
npm-debug.log*
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db
```

## Dockerfile

```dockerfile
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Stage 1 — "deps"
#   Install ONLY production dependencies.
#   This layer is cached separately so rebuilds after code-only
#   changes don't reinstall packages.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps

# Install security updates and the toolchain needed by native addons.
# Remove the cache immediately to keep the layer small.
RUN apk add --no-cache libc6-compat

WORKDIR /app

# Copy manifests first — Docker cache is invalidated only when these
# files change, not when source code changes.
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# --omit=dev   → skip devDependencies
# --frozen-lockfile → fail fast if lock file is out of sync
# --prefer-offline → use the local npm cache when possible
RUN npm ci --omit=dev --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Stage 2 — "builder"
#   Install ALL dependencies (including devDeps) and compile TS.
#   This stage is never shipped to production.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder

RUN apk add --no-cache libc6-compat

WORKDIR /app

COPY package.json package-lock.json ./

# Install everything, including devDependencies (tsc, @types/*, etc.)
RUN npm ci --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline

# Copy source code AFTER installing dependencies so that code changes
# don't bust the npm-install cache layer.
COPY tsconfig.json ./
COPY src/ ./src/

# Compile TypeScript → JavaScript into ./dist
RUN npm run build

# Optional: run your test suite here so a failing test prevents the
# image from being built.
# RUN npm test


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Stage 3 — "runner"  (final, production image)
#   Copy only what is strictly needed to execute the compiled app:
#     • the compiled JS from the builder stage
#     • the production node_modules from the deps stage
#   Everything else (source, devDeps, tsc, lock files) is discarded.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS runner

# ── Security hardening ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Run as a non-root user with a fixed UID/GID so the container
# behaves consistently across host systems.
RUN addgroup --system --gid 1001 appgroup && \
    adduser  --system --uid 1001 --ingroup appgroup appuser

WORKDIR /app

# Set NODE_ENV so any library that checks it behaves correctly
# (e.g. Express strips stack traces from error responses).
ENV NODE_ENV=production \
    PORT=3000

# Copy production node_modules from the "deps" stage
COPY --from=deps    --chown=appuser:appgroup /app/node_modules ./node_modules

# Copy compiled output from the "builder" stage
COPY --from=builder --chown=appuser:appgroup /app/dist        ./dist

# Optional: copy package.json so `process.env.npm_package_version`
# and other npm_package_* variables work at runtime.
COPY --chown=appuser:appgroup package.json ./

# Drop to the non-root user before the final CMD
USER appuser

EXPOSE 3000

# Use the tini-compatible node init system built into the Alpine image
# ("dumb-init" alternative) — passes signals correctly to Node.js
# so SIGTERM causes a graceful shutdown instead of a forced kill.
ENTRYPOINT ["node"]

# Point directly at the compiled entry point (no npm run start) to
# keep PID 1 as the Node process, not a shell.
CMD ["dist/index.js"]
```

## Build & Run Commands

```bash
# Build the image
docker build \
  --target runner \
  --tag my-ts-app:latest \
  .

# Run the container
docker run \
  --rm \
  --init \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  --env-file .env \
  my-ts-app:latest

# Inspect the final image size
docker image inspect my-ts-app:latest --format '{{.Size}}' | \
  awk '{printf "%.1f MB\n", $1/1024/1024}'

# Multi-platform build (for Apple Silicon / CI environments)
docker buildx build \
  --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
  --tag my-ts-app:latest \
  --push \
  .
```

## Docker Compose (Optional)

```yaml
# docker-compose.yml
version: "3.9"

services:
  app:
    build:
      context: .
      target: runner          # use the production stage
    image: my-ts-app:latest
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: 3000
    env_file:
      - .env
    restart: unless-stopped
    read_only: true            # make root filesystem read-only
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp                   # allow writes only to /tmp
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true # prevent privilege escalation
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://localhost:3000/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s

  # Development override — mount source & run ts-node
  # Usage: docker-compose --profile dev up
  app-dev:
    profiles: ["dev"]
    build:
      context: .
      target: builder         # use the builder stage (has devDeps)
    volumes:
      - ./src:/app/src:ro
    command: ["npx", "ts-node", "src/index.ts"]
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: development
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
```

## Why Each Decision Was Made

| Decision | Reason |
|---|---|
| `node:20-alpine` base | ~50 MB vs ~900 MB for `node:20`; minimal attack surface |
| Separate `deps` stage | Production `node_modules` cached independently from compilation |
| `npm ci --omit=dev` | Strips devDependencies (tsc, @types, etc.) from final image |
| `--frozen-lockfile` | Fails fast if `package-lock.json` is stale |
| Non-root `appuser` | Prevents container breakout from escalating to host root |
| `ENTRYPOINT ["node"]` | Node is PID 1; receives OS signals (SIGTERM) correctly |
| `.dockerignore` | Keeps build context small; prevents local `node_modules` leaking in |
| `--chown` on `COPY` | Sets correct ownership without an extra `RUN chown` layer |
